posts.text:
A portal is not a website.

A website tells people who you are. A portal is where your clients, suppliers or staff log in and do things: see their statements, download their documents, approve a quote, raise a request, track a job.

We build portals that sit on top of the systems a business already runs: one login, English and Arabic, PIN approvals for anything that moves money, QR-verified PDFs, and a full audit trail of who did what.

The fastest way to see whether your business needs one: pick your business type in the live demo and look at the client and staff views. demo.global-link.ae

Software that runs the whole business 💡

HR, payroll, projects, accounting, apps for staff and customers, bilingual websites — built in Abu Dhabi for UAE companies.

30 seconds on what we do. Then see your own system in the live demo — link in bio.

#UAEBusiness #AbuDhabi #BusinessSoftware #SmallBusinessUAE #PayrollUAE #HRSystem #Reels #GlobalLinkAE

The most expensive process in a company is the one nobody owns.

The leave request that lives in WhatsApp. The purchase that gets approved by a phone call. The invoice that waits for someone to "check the file".

Automation here is not robots. It is giving each of those a form, a rule and an approver, so it moves by itself and leaves a record. A PIN approval instead of a call. A document that generates itself from data already in the system. A reminder that fires before the deadline instead of after.

We start with the three processes that cost the most time and build from there.

Which process in your company has no owner today?
